result.title: Defect-Aware Masked Autoencoders for Unsupervised Clustering of Steel Surface Defects
result.summary: Reliable recognition of steel surface defects is essential for automated quality inspection, but supervised methods require manually annotated images that are costly to produce. This creates a need for methods that can learn useful defect representations directly from unlabelled surface images. This work presents Defect aware MAE, a label free masked autoencoder for clustering steel surface defects. Each image is divided into 196 patches, with 147 masked and 49 processed by a Vision Transformer encoder. Texture energy based masking preferentially hides structurally informative patches, while a shallow decoder reconstructs HOG descriptors that capture local texture and edge orientation. Strong augmentation and an intermediate layer readout are used to form the final image features. Pretraining uses no class labels, bounding boxes, detection branch, or contrastive loss. On the held out NEU DET split, UMAP followed by Ward clustering achieves 98.6% Hungarian matched accuracy, 0.968 NMI, 0.967 ARI, and 0.838 silhouette score. Under an identical encoder and training schedule, it exceeds a SimCLR contrastive baseline in accuracy, NMI, ARI and silhouette scores across 5 seeds.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出一种无需标签的 defect-aware MAE，用纹理能量引导的 patch 掩码与 HOG 描述子重建预训练，对钢材表面缺陷图像特征做无监督聚类。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究面向工业缺陷检测的无监督表示学习与聚类，不涉及 VLM 推理、latent 推理状态生成、证据获取或停止决策，纹理引导掩码也只是预训练增强手段，未见可供核查的 LVR 迁移线索。
